ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Actions (v2.0)[/h1] Composite ToolCall orchestration and tactical emergency execution engine for RimWorld colonists. Translates high-level AI intentions into safe, multi-step in-game operations—covering battlefield triage, autonomous blueprint construction, agricultural cycles, social interactions, and survival responses.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 Composite ToolCall Architecture[/b]: Combines atomic Core mechanisms into stateful, multi-stage workflows registered purely through [code]RimMind-Core[/code] public ToolCall contracts. [*][b]Multi-Stage Job Polling & Safety Gates[/b]: Continuously tracks complex jobs (such as [code]Blueprint_Build[/code] to [code]Frame[/code] delivery and construction) while enforcing strict material reserve and danger-proximity guards. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]10 Built-In Composite Mechanisms[/b] - High-level orchestrated tools covering emergency survival, construction engineering, and agricultural production. [*][b]ContinuousJobPoller Multi-Stage Lifecycle[/b] - Tracks multi-step Verse job execution across ticks, seamlessly advancing from blueprint placement to material hauling and frame completion. [*][b]ActionPermissionGuard & ResourceSafetyGuard[/b] - Validates active spawned colonist eligibility, work-type capabilities, hostile threat proximity, and colony resource reserve thresholds before executing any job. [*][b]Graded Risk Control[/b] - Every action carries an explicit risk classification ([i]Low / Medium / High / Critical[/i]) that integrates directly with Core's 3-Tier Autonomy and Advisor's player approval workflow. [*][b]Main-Thread Safe Execution[/b] - Dispatches all Verse and Unity side effects safely on the main game thread. [/list]

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Can RimMind-Actions be used standalone?[/b] A: Actions registers composite tools into [code]RimMind-Core[/code]. Pair it with [code]RimMind-Advisor[/code] so AI colonists can autonomously propose and execute these mechanisms.
[b]Q: Will AI colonists waste scarce resources on blueprints?[/b] A: No. [code]ResourceSafetyGuard[/code] verifies colony material reserves before placing blueprints, and high-impact actions respect your approval settings.
